description: This file defines the JobTitleMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to job titles within the HR Management software. It overrides the current screen to display the job title list.

classes.name: JobTitleMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for job title-related screens, overrides screen to display list of job titles.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewJobTitleList' for the job title management menu.
